translation.name: Kalam Baybol Buk Gor minim nuk kisin angayak

book.name: Luk
book.title: LUK Jiysis Krays Minim Tep Luk Tikak

content: Tap Siy Tap Timey Giy Apyap Pikpay

Jiysis binuk gok kuyip aŋgak, “Biyn bap akaŋ, bi bap miñ timey ar ak giy, biynimb gunap kuyip gos ñey, ar kun ak giy apyap pikpay ak; timey yimb gip. Miñ ar kun ak nind giyiŋgipay, miñiy gipay, kisen kunep giniŋgambay. Pen gipay kun ak rek, yiwur kun ak key yimb diniŋgambay.

Kiyk won kun siŋak nep, giniŋg giyakniŋ, kuyip kamb yomb bap, kuŋam ak sek miñ aybirikiy, dam ñiŋg yokpiyap ak, kuyip tep gipyap. Yenen: kiyk kim mindiy, biynimb yip ker ñin tomb wos ma gip gunap, kuyip gey apyap pikniŋgambay ak, yiwur yomb yimb diniŋgambay.
Kun ak nimb asik tep ginimimb. Pen mam akaŋ, ay bap tap siy tap timey gonimuŋ, nup niŋchikiy aŋgem, yenen kun gipiyn aŋgiy niŋonimuŋ; niŋiy kirginimimb.
Pen tap nimbip rek gunap timey giyiŋg, yenen kun gipiyn aŋgiy, ap aŋgonimuŋ, niŋiy kirginimimb. Ñin nokom bap, kun gek gek onep ar ak rek amek, kunep niŋiy kirginimimb aŋgak.”
Gor Nup Gosimb Niŋbay
Jiysis kun aŋgek, binuk gok aŋgyak, “Chin key kun ginjun rek ma ayip; kuyip yiruk niŋjun rek ayip. Kun ak nand gey, chin Gor nup gosimb nokom niŋon, chinup kond mindakniŋ, kun ginjun aŋgyak.”

Aŋgey, Jiysis kuyip aŋgak, “Pen Gor nup gosimb niŋbim ak yomb mer: mon mastet maŋgiy achimb rek nep mindek; aŋgniŋgambim, ‘Mon biy junj sek jiwiy, ñiŋg yomb namb siŋbindoŋ, jak mindey aŋgem,’ Gor aŋgniŋgambim rek nep giniŋgamb.
Bi Woŋg Giñemb

“Bi bap, bi woŋg giñemb nuk bap diy aŋgek, am man piŋiy paŋgiy akaŋ, kanj siypsiyp gok mok taŋgiy, andkind korip apek, biyomb nuk ak, nup yerip aŋgniŋgamb? ‘Nip yiwan gip, kasek ap bisgiy tap ñiŋan aŋgniŋgamb?’
Mer! Kun ma aŋgniŋgamb. Nuk aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Chech ak dey apek, ler ak aybirikiy, ñiŋg tap yip gok dapey ñimben, kisen ñiŋg tap nand gok ñiŋan aŋgniŋgamb.’
Bi woŋg giñemb nuk ak, aŋgniŋgamb rek gek, nup minim tep gunap ma aŋgniŋgamb. ‘Bi woŋg giñemb yand ak mey, apiyn rek gip aŋgniŋgamb.’
“Kun ak rek mey nimb. Gor nimbip aŋgniŋgamb rek giy, kisen aŋgniŋgambim, ‘Chin biynimb tep mer: ar bap key ma gipun; woŋg chin gep rek ak mey, gipun aŋgniŋgambim’ aŋgak.”
Bi Soy Aydik Ayak Onep Wanjrem Ak Gek Suŋ Ayak
Jiysis Jerusalem amniyn aŋgiy, miñmon Samariya biy Galiyliy bindoŋ, namb ak am am miñmon bap amjakakniŋ,
bi soy ayndik ayak onep wanjrem ak, nup namb pikiy, keykey siŋbindoŋ mindiy,
aŋgyak, “Biyomb Jiysis. Chinup simb niŋan aŋgyak.”
Aŋgeyak, kuyip aŋgak, “Nimbip suŋ ayip nen, am bi Gor nup simboŋgep gok kuyip, yomnimimb aŋgak.” Kun aŋgek, kinjeŋnamb okok amniyakniŋ, kuyip maŋgiysek suŋ ayek,
bi Samariya nimb ak nup suŋ ayak ak niŋiy, minim yomb aŋgyiŋg, Gor nup yimb ak dand aranyiŋg,
andkind ap Jiysis mindek siŋak koŋgim yimiy, nup “Tep” aŋgak.
Kun gek niŋiy, Jiysis aŋgak, “Yand aŋgniŋbiyn-eŋ; bi onep wanjrem ak suŋ ayip aŋgiy niŋbiyn ak pen; bi onep anjip ak akay?
Bi gunap yenen ma opay? Bi par okok nimb ak nep apiy, Gor nup tep aŋgip aŋgak.”
Kun aŋgiy, bi kun anup aŋgak, “Jiysis yip gek, suŋ ayniŋgamb aŋgiy gos ak niŋban rek, nip gen suŋ ayip nen, amnoŋ aŋgak.”
Gor Biynimb Diy Kond Mindeniŋgamb

Pen bi Peresiy gok, Jiysis nup aŋgyak, “Kiyŋ yomb key per kond mindpun ak ñin akay rek apiy, chinup diy kond mindeniŋgamb?” Aŋgey, Jiysis aŋgak, “Biyomb biynimb diy kond mindeniŋgamb apim kun ak, biyomb kiyŋ gunap, biynimb miseŋ kond mindey niŋiy apay,
‘Biynimb kond mindip biy, kond mindip bindoŋ apay’ rek ma aŋgniŋgambim. Yenen, nuk nimbip bak ay, kapkap kond mindeniŋgamb aŋgak.”
Kun aŋgiy, binuk gok kuyip aŋgak, “Kisen ñin bap, Bi bap Ñinuk nup niŋun aŋgiy, mapin nimbip ak, piŋiyñiy nep ayniŋgamb ak pen, nup miseŋ ma niŋniŋgambim.
Biynimb gunap mindip bindoŋ, mindip biy aŋgey, minim kun ak niŋind apay aŋgiy, ma am piyow niŋnimimb.
Yenen: Bi bap Ñinuk winiŋgamb ñin ak, añiñak diy, melik parsek gip rek ak, gakniŋ winiŋgamb.
Pen biynimb miñiy mindpay gok, nup yiruk niŋiy ma dey; yiwur yomb yimb ak diy, kumiy tikjak semb biyoŋ amiy, kisen tip ak winiŋgamb.
“Nuk winiŋgamb ñin kun ak, wosrey Nowa mindek ñin ak, gak rek giniŋgamb.

Biynimb gok tap ñimbyiŋg, ñiŋg ñimbyiŋg, biyn penpen ñiyiŋg gi mindyakniŋ, Nowa amyoŋg apyoŋgon siyip miŋgan sikind amdey, miñmon yomb sikerek ak pikiy, ñiŋg wilik apiy, biynimb kun gok kuyip, maŋgiysek yiwiŋgdek kumyak.
“Pen bi Lot mindek ñin ak, Sodom Gomora biynimb gok kunep tap ñimbyiŋg, ñiŋg ñimbyiŋg, sikyim giyiŋg, tap woŋg giyiŋg, korip giyiŋg gi mindyakniŋ,
Lot miñmon kun ak kirgiy, miñmon wikan bap key amnakniŋ, mon maŋlaŋ yomb yimb ak, semb biyoŋ nimb apiy, Sodom Gomora biynimb kuyip, maŋgiysek yin simbok amnak.
Bi bap, Ñinuk winiŋgamb ñin ak; Nowa mindyiŋgip ñin ak sek, Lot mindyiŋgip ñin ak sek gi mindyiŋgipay rek, gi mindeniŋgambay.
“Ñin kun ak, biynimb korip ar biyoŋ mindeniŋgiy gok, tap kiyk gok diniŋg, korip miŋgan ma amniŋgiy. Pen biynimb woŋgday okok taŋgeniŋgiy gok, tap gunap diniŋg, andkind korip ma amniŋgiy.
Lot biynuk nup gak ar ak niŋnimimb.

Pen biynimb key nep mindiy, mindrep giniŋgayn aŋgniŋgambay gok, mon key yinjap ak amniŋgambay. Biynimb Jiysis ker minden, yip pikayniŋg pikayniŋgiy aŋgiy, yip kisen giniŋgambay gok, biynimb yand yimb mindiy mey, perper mindeniŋgambay.
Nimbip aspiyn: ñin kun ak, bi omiŋal minj ar nokom bap, kineniŋgayr ak; Gor bi bap nup diy, bap nup kirginiŋgamb.
Pen biyn omiŋal biret jimñiy gi mindeniŋgayr ak; bap diy, bap nup kirginiŋgamb.
[Bi omiŋal woŋgday okok taŋgeniŋgayr ak; bap diy, bap nup kirginiŋgamb aŋgak.]”
Kun aŋgek aŋgyak, “Biyomb. Minim aspan kun ak, akay kun giniŋgamb?” Aŋgey, Jiysis aŋgak, “Miñ miŋgan, mon miŋgan, kamb miŋgan okok ma giniŋgamb; miseŋ nep namb siŋak giniŋgamb aŋgak.”
